item.title: A public footpath is blocked in two places by live electrified fencing., 16th September
item.description:
There are two electrified fences on Shurdington Hill at OS locations 92694/17904 and 92916/17808. The only way to continue one's walk is to roll underneath the wire, which is not easy for an older person like me (80). I presume the purpose is to restrict the movement of livestock, though I only saw one cow this morning (16/9/26).
